title: Retaining the urine-creatinine denominator does not establish robust incremental CRP prediction across NHANES samples
abstract: Adding log spot urine creatinine to a flexible ACR/demographic/BMI/smoking/serum-creatinine model improved weighted Brier error by 0.00020467 in 5,560 NHANES 2009–2010 adults, but the source-and-target PSU-refit bootstrap interval (-0.00016485, 0.00054835) included zero and source cross-validation worsened. Robust incremental inflammation prediction was not established.
